question: The headquarters of the World Bank is situated at:
solution:
The correct answer is **__Washington DC, USA.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** headquarters of the World Bank is in Washington D.C. of the United States of America(USA).**
 
• It has a total membership of **189 countries**.
 
• It was established in the year** 1944.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• ​The World Bank is an **international financial institution** that provides loans and grants to the governments of low- and middle-income countries for the purpose of pursuing capital projects.
 
• It comprises two institutions**: the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD), and the International Development Association(IDA).**
 
• Some important International Organizations and their Headquarters:
 
 
• World Economic Forum - Cologny, Switzerland.
 
• UNESCO - Paris, France.
 
• UNICEF - New York.
 
• WHO - Geneva.
 
• UNDP - New York.
 
• SAARC - Kathmandu.
 
• BRICS - Shanghai, China.
